title: Terrain / satellite surface and ringworld
goal: Inspect the real satellite imagery on the driving terrain. Check field and road alignment, distant transitions and driving performance. The full 8192-pixel source covers about 90 km, or 11 m per pixel.
changes: Replaces the plain green ground with the existing full-resolution Millstreet satellite image. Mipmaps and compressed texture caching keep it practical at the 120 FPS cap. The same image is shared with the home backdrop. Warthog settings, terrain geometry, collision and saved caches are retained. Fine grass/rock surface detail is a later refinement.
controls: WASD drive; Space brake; C chase/driver camera; hold RMB to look; Home centres look. E switches between driving and inspection flight. R places the Warthog upright on loaded ground at its current location. F5 opens the existing vehicle setup; F2 opens this brief. In flight: WASD, Space/Ctrl vertical, Shift faster. Enter starts when ready. F8 starts/stops jitter capture, including the preceding five seconds of suspension, contact, camera and frame history. Logs are saved automatically.
